SELECT relation.account_id AS accountId, member.account AS account, member.name AS name, relation.create_by AS createBy, creator.name AS createByName, relation.create_time AS createTime FROM account_role relation INNER JOIN account member ON member.id = relation.account_id AND member.enterprise_id = relation.enterprise_id AND member.account_type = 2 AND member.deleted = 1 LEFT JOIN account creator ON creator.id = relation.create_by AND (creator.enterprise_id = relation.enterprise_id OR creator.account_type = 1) WHERE relation.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND relation.role_id = #{roleId} AND relation.deleted = 1
AND (member.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%') OR member.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%'))
ORDER BY relation.create_time DESC, relation.id DESC

SELECT member.id AS accountId, member.account AS account, member.name AS name, member.status AS status FROM account member WHERE member.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND member.account_type = 2 AND member.deleted = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_role relation WHERE relation.enterprise_id = member.enterprise_id AND relation.account_id = member.id AND relation.role_id = #{roleId} AND relation.deleted = 1 )
AND (member.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%') OR member.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%'))
ORDER BY member.create_time DESC, member.id DESC
